p: A stubborn and rebellious son is sentenced
on account of his ultimate end,
because the death of the wicked is beneficial to them, … and … beneficial to the world, … of the righteous is detrimental to them, … and … detrimental to the world,

because the death of the wicked is beneficial to them, because they can no longer sin, and it is also beneficial to the world, which is now rid of those who do it harm. Conversely, the death of the righteous is detrimental to them, as they can no longer engage in the performance of mitzvot, and it is also detrimental to the world,

p: wine and sleep of the wicked are beneficial to them and beneficial to the world, … And, … of the righteous are detrimental to them and detrimental to the world,
